region_scene_page.compact: Thrash took traditional metal's technical force and pushed it into faster, sharper underground forms in the 1980s.
region_scene_page.standard: Thrash took traditional metal's technical force and pushed it into faster, sharper underground forms in the 1980s. Metallica's Whiplash, Megadeth's Wake Up Dead, Anthrax's Madhouse, and Slayer's Raining Blood give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Thrash took traditional metal's technical force and pushed it into faster, sharper underground forms in the 1980s. The sound is defined by riff motion, tempo, and precision more than pop hooks or blues swing. Metallica's Whiplash, Megadeth's Wake Up Dead, Anthrax's Madhouse, and Slayer's Raining Blood give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.

canonical_examples.current_graph_why_it_belongs: Agent Orange adds mission-usable thrash and speed-metal depth beyond the Big Four gateways.
